keyFindings.description: Round 1's `refused` category now catches a gateway's 408 timeout and 429 rate limit (DispatchGatewayError extends DispatchServiceError; HttpStatusError from readJson too), which printed `transport` before. The shared client treats 408/429 as transient (`transientStatus`, packages/envoy-client/src/dispatch-http.ts:225-226), and the README describes `refused` as a request Dispatch rejects, so the operator is sent to fix a query a retry would answer. Check the client's transient rule before the 4xx branch and add a 429 case to the gateway test.each.

The 'body that is not JSON is malformed' test feeds a string into the fake coverage() and never runs readJson, so reverting readJson to a throw (printing `transport`) would still pass. Test the real read against a local Bun.serve answering HTML.
readJson's comment says it answers text 'as DispatchClient does'; DispatchClient parses only a JSON content-type (dispatch-http.ts:908-915), readJson parses every body.

Category lists `no-results` and `config`, which no Category value carries; A1's reason is inferred from verdict `unavailable`. Carry the category on A1Judgement's unavailable branch as PairResult and CoverageResult do, and route or drop `config`.

Says only a missing or failed lexeme database prints `shared=unchecked`; a failed issue read prints `shared=unchecked position=<…> unavailable: <category>` too (checkPair :373-380, formatPair :449-451).

declined: Code quality's 'merge checkCoverage into checkA3': not a defect; the read callback keeps the retry loop separate from the read, and both are exercised through runChecks.
